basic_info.description: Perched atop the coveted north slope of Bernal Heights, 53 Elsie Street is a retreat that frames the San Francisco skyline like a work of art. This thoughtfully appointed residence offers Dolby Atmos speakers throughout, automated window treatments, integrated appliances, and bifold glass doors that lead seamlessly to the expansive lower deck—perfect for indoor-outdoor living. The oversized primary suite features its own upper deck and arguably the best views in Bernal. This home even has a gated doggie lawn for all of you with fur babies! Just blocks from Precita Park, Bernal Heights Park, and the vibrant Cortland corridor, this home offers the perfect blend of convenience and luxury, with effortless access to transit and freeways. 53 Elsie is a rare gem for those who appreciate timeless architecture and breathtaking, panoramic views.
